observations.description: No network/credential/pickle/live imports. Only hashlib, json, os, pathlib, uuid, paper_exchange_adapter_v1, paper_gateway_checkpoint_v1 used. trading_authority=False in payload, receipts, and round-trip.
Single atomic unit: gateway checkpoint + receipts + adapter_id in one envelope. adapter_id binds complete gateway snapshot + receipt history. No split-brain.
Deterministic serialization: identical states produce identical bytes, UTF-8 canonical JSON, round-trip preserves exact state, receipt order preserved.

Integrity: outer payload SHA-256 checked, nested gateway checkpoint integrity independently checked (snapshot_from_bytes), adapter_id independently verified, receipt mutation/deletion/insertion rejects with recompute, trading_authority tamper rejects at payload and receipt layer.

Schema: missing/unknown/duplicate fields reject, unsupported schema rejects, empty/truncated/malformed/non-UTF-8/oversized reject, receipts must be list, non-boolean accepted rejects, invalid reason rejects, non-False trading_authority rejects.

Filesystem safety: missing parent rejects, existing checkpoint cannot be overwritten by initialize, existing lock fails closed, lock contention preserves checkpoint, missing checkpoint load rejects, temp files in checkpoint dir.
Atomic replacement: os.replace, os.fsync, stream.flush, temp cleaned after success/failure, lock cleaned after normal exceptions, repeated transactions no artifacts.

Transactional execution: store loads authoritative under lock, execute→verify→replace forms one transaction, exact retry no duplicate, conflicting retry rejected, gateway-rejected remains idempotent, stale in-memory cannot overwrite.
Crash windows: failure before load preserves checkpoint (lock contention), failure during execution no false acceptance, failure preserves prior checkpoint.
Restart: atomically sets connected=false, reconciliation_required=true, preserves records, deterministic, submission blocked after restart.

Reconciliation: under writer lock, exact observation required, mismatch durably persisted with kill_switch+disconnected, exact restores, cannot clear kill switch, never grants trading authority, stale snapshot rejects.
Recovery from incomplete artifacts: empty, truncated, and corrupt checkpoints all reject safely. No guessing which state is authoritative.
Failure normalization: JSON, Unicode, size, and checksum errors all surface as PaperAdapterCheckpointError. No raw exceptions create unclear behavior.
Implementation coupling: imports only paper_exchange_adapter_v1 and paper_gateway_checkpoint_v1 public contracts. No private helpers used.

accepted_after_correction: test_stale_in_memory_cannot_overwrite (corrected: same command_id gets IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY before STALE check — need a new command_id with stale snapshot_id to test stale binding)
